message:
The key line is `h2o_sendvec_t bufs[inbufcnt + 1 + 2];` at line 997 in http1.c. This is a VLA (variable-length array). The crash is "Non-positive-vla-bound-value", meaning `inbufcnt + 1 + 2` is non-positive, i.e., `inbufcnt` is negative (or the sum overflows). Since `inbufcnt` is `size_t` (unsigned), it can't be negative unless there's an integer overflow. Let me look at the fuzzer target and the code around `finalostream_send`.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>find /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/h2o/fuzz -name "*.c" -o -name "*.cc" | xargs grep -l "http1\|LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput" 2>/dev/null && echo "---" && sed -n '960,1100p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/h2o/lib/http1.c</parameter>
